messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-05-23] standup/ember/2025-05-23: The Ember team saw that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Boreal starting today; Lena is off rotation.
- [2025-12-23] handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway: From today the pager for auth-gateway rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25: Marcus picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18: Oskar Lind picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2025-05-05] standup/boreal/2025-05-05: Reminder that the billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.
- [2025-05-08] standup/boreal/2025-05-08: Boreal saw that the catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-09-23] standup/cinder/2025-09-23: Cinder has switched to trunk-based development.
- [2025-06-23] standup/atlas/2025-06-23: The quarterly capacity review is run by Priya.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-01-13] standup/boreal/2025-01-13: Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08: The Boreal team on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-04-23] standup/atlas/2026-04-23: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-06-23] standup/cinder/2025-06-23: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-12-23] standup/atlas/2025-12-23: The Atlas team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-26] handover/2026-05-26-billing-api: Ownership change: billing-api now sits with the Dune team. Boreal no longer owns it.
- [2026-02-23] standup/dune/2026-02-23: The job scheduler deploy window (unchanged): on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-05-05] standup/dune/2025-05-05: For newcomers: the deploy window for the catalog is still on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-02-27] standup/boreal/2025-02-27: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation. Team Boreal noticed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-09] standup/atlas/2025-05-09: Reminder from Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-05-09] standup/dune/2025-05-09-2: The Dune team has switched to a monthly game day.
- [2025-05-09] standup/dune/2025-05-09: Reporting must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.
- [2025-12-05] standup/cinder/2025-12-05: Team change: Diego Alvarez leaves team Cinder and joins Ember, effective today.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2: Team Cinder noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-01-05] standup/cinder/2026-01-05: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-07-17] standup/dune/2025-07-17: Reminder: Farah is on call for Dune this cycle.
- [2025-01-16] standup/dune/2025-01-16: First on-call rotation for team Dune goes to Farah Haddad.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2: Heads-up from Atlas: the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18-2: The Ember team noticed that auth-gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar Lind is on call for the Ember team to start the year.
- [2025-01-14] standup/cinder/2025-01-14: Yuki takes the first team Cinder on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-07-10] standup/cinder/2025-07-10: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation.
